notes.title: Devlog #2 for Update 0.2.2.0 - Seasons, Brightness & Fertilizer Features
notes.content:
General Brightness & Post-Processing Settings
Some players had trouble navigating in darker environments. This was due to our different settings for various weather types. We’ve now adjusted the post-processing effects for all weather conditions, both day and night. As a result, interiors and exteriors are now always bright enough to find your way around comfortably.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/2b833cb0ecdf5b48af1a10c8c926825741d9729b.gif

Seasons
In addition to the new brightness adjustments, the weather system has also been reworked: it’s no longer completely random. Instead, you’ll now experience season-typical conditions:

December to February: Winter
March to May: Spring
June to August: Summer
September to November: Autumn

Note: This is based on in-game time, not real-world time or your PC calendar.

Reminder: Your in-game calendar may reset with this update. If that happens, don’t worry — no progress will be lost. The game will simply start on March 1st.

Horse Editor UI Overhaul
The Horse Editor has received a fresh, cleaner design!  
Additionally, these changes have been made:

A new button lets you open your screenshot folder directly
Camera and horse rotation are now controlled with the mouse instead of buttons

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/79fbb26aecea3954daff41168569b6596e08879e.png

Fertilizer
Until now, processed fertilizer could only be sold — that changes now!  
From now on, you can fertilize:

Fields
Raised beds
Trees

to boost your harvest yields.

Multiple Names for Your Horses
At the community’s request, we’ve added the ability for horses to carry two names at once.  
Additionally, the UI for renaming horses in the Horse Editor and during purchase has been slightly updated.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/6229923e5bd95eef24f33890450dc46f1c3383a9.png

Horse Poop Function
The poop system has been completely rebuilt. Horses will now only poop twice per day — once in the morning and once in the evening. Old piles disappear the next day (at 6:00 AM). There's now a system behind it — previously, it was random.

Sound Effects
We’ve started integrating new sound effects. Each one is carefully edited, trimmed, and acoustically optimized.  
To avoid repetitive patterns, several variations of similar sounds are used.

Tack Sets – Rework
We’re currently working on updating the Kingston, Kentucky, and L'Aquila tack sets to give them a fresher and more fitting look for Unbridled.  
Here’s a preview of the Kentucky and L'Aquila sets:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/298b962f55ca00d15a1b0de154277f9fc03d9ea8.gif

Miscellaneous
As the number of functions, variables, and macros continued to grow, the code became increasingly complex. To address this, we’ve invested time in a thorough cleanup and restructuring process.  
Our goal was to remove redundant elements, improve organization, and significantly increase readability and maintainability. These measures lay a more stable foundation for future development and long-term maintenance.

Note
All content is currently in WIP (Work in Progress) status and may change before release!
As always, you can follow our progress live on our public roadmap:  
>> View public roadmap here <<

notes.title: Devlog #1 for Update 0.2.2.0 - UI, Tools & Tack Sets in Focus
notes.content:
Job Board – Rework
In our last team meeting, we reviewed all menus and their associated user interfaces. The Job Board stood out the most: while it served its purpose, it was far from visually appealing. 
Alongside newly created board meshes, we’ve now added job offers in the form of flyers. The entire board – including the flyers – is interactive and much more engaging and easy to navigate. Jobs are now divided into categories and can be instantly recognized thanks to custom-made stamps, even before you interact with the board.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/76112d273924f139bb99313f7c086f04ae98d031.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/3036ecebaec33afb469c503dd89b6aedf7d73e11.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/4f4027e50e42a4bae8c0a05f627014713e646f23.png

Player Creator & Horse Creator – UI Rework
The user interfaces and overall menu layout have also been reworked. Navigation in both menus is now handled with vector graphics, represented by clear, easy-to-recognize icons. In addition, some information and buttons have been rearranged. The camera can now be controlled with the right mouse button.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/540d87ebc8524692bc56a64ea9b90e182147fb43.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/a0e98cafa0924947c2a02ef04705050a333a0571.png

Tree Chopping & Ore Mining – Rework
Interacting with chop-able trees and mineable rocks now works similarly to other interactive world objects, such as doors. The key difference is that players now have two new equipment slots in their inventory, where the required tool must be equipped in order to interact with trees or rocks. 
The meshes for the axe and pickaxe, along with their animations, have also been reworked. These adjustments were necessary to make interactions independent of FPS.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/8fca28b69647075ead0c7718cff3acb850f24346.png

Tack Sets – Rework
We’re currently working on updating the Kingston, Kentucky, and L'Aquila tack sets to give them a fresher and more fitting look for Unbridled. Here’s a preview of the Kingston Tack Set along with some new design ideas.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/44d274a944d53b38572b35223b0310addfe79f5c.gif

Miscellaneous
In addition to these larger changes, we’re also working on smaller adjustments and quality-of-life improvements. These include quick access to the mailbox via the menu bar as well as new highlight effects when interacting with certain world objects.

Public Roadmap
We’re constantly updating our public roadmap to keep everyone informed: 
>> Visit the Roadmap here <<

_________

Note
All content is currently in WIP (Work in Progress) status and may change before release!

notes.title: Public Roadmaps for Early Access Version 0.2.2.0 & 0.3.0.0
notes.content:
After two extensive team meetings discussing Update 0.2.2.0 and Update 0.3.0.0, we are excited to finally share our feature lineup with you! As always, this update comes with a public roadmap, so you can follow our progress step by step.  

>> Visit the Roadmap here <<

Upcoming Early Access 0.2.2.0 Update
General

 An issue with the game being too dark will be fixed  
 Steam Cloud Save support will be added  
 New sound effects will be introduced  
 The UI for processing will be updated  
 A general UI overhaul will be carried out  
 The inbox icon and UI will be refreshed  
 Player Creator UI will receive improvements  

Maps

 The job board will be overhauled  
 A floating character issue will be fixed  
 Mining/collecting will be reworked  
 A value save function between maps will be added  
 Fertilizer usability will be implemented  

Functions

 A player run toggle will be introduced  

Animations & 3D

 Tack for Kingston will be overhauled and improved  
 Tack for Kentucky will be overhauled and improved  
 Tack for L’Aquila will be overhauled and improved  
 New animation changes for the character creator will be added  
 A chopped tree model and animation will be introduced  
 Pickaxe and axe animations and models will be reworked  
 New trees and vegetation will be added  
 A new pinboard model will be included  

Horses

 Fatigue will be displayed starting at 0 (instead of only at 20)  
 Horse poop amounts will be reduced  
 Two name text boxes + a show name option for horses will be added  
 Bonding XP gain will be increased  
 The untack area for front boots will be adjusted to the middle horse area  
 Fatigue will rise faster  

Other

 German translation fixes will be applied  

This patch will refine core systems, improve usability, and polish many visual and gameplay elements to make the experience smoother and more enjoyable.  

The big Early Access 0.3.0.0 Update
General

 Show Jumping Competitions: Players will be able to participate in show jumping events to earn money and prizes with their horses.  
 Riding Lessons (Tutorials): A structured introduction to the riding system will help new players become familiar with horse handling and controls.  

Multiplayer

 Ongoing work will improve latency issues during horse jumping, ensuring smoother and more responsive multiplayer experiences.  

Maps

 Campground Rework & Expansion: A refreshed design with expanded areas for exploration and activities will be introduced.  

Functions

 Horse Ability System Overhaul: The system will be redesigned for more dynamic progression, giving players greater freedom in training their horses.  
 Riding Controls Update: Handling will be improved for more intuitive and responsive riding.  
 Visual Breed Shapes: Distinctive body shapes for each horse breed will be added.  
 Horse AI Overhaul, including:  
   
    Random pasture roaming will be improved  
    Grazing behavior will be enhanced  
    Eating & drinking in pastures will be added  
    Herd behavior and social interactions will be introduced  
    Horses will use sheds for shelter  
    Horses will clean each other  
    Player and horse perception will be upgraded  
     
 Horse Hair Growth & Coat Clipping: Natural hair growth over time and coat clipping will be implemented. 

Animations & 3D

 Horse Animations for the new Horse Model:  
   
    Walk, trot, canter, gallop
    Jumping
    Leg-yield (left & right)
    Halts & turns
    Interactions, idles, pasture, and stall animations
     
 New Horse Model Finalization will be completed  
 Breed Shape Finalization:  
   
    Arabian  
    Shire Horse  
    Marwari  
    Mustang  
    Friesian  
    Andalusian  
    Fjord  
    Haflinger  
    Quarter Horse  
     
 Tack Mesh Refitting: Tack will properly fit across all breed shapes.  
 New Horse Manes & Tails:  
   
    Buttoned, straight, wavy, braided styles  
    Thick mane & tail variations
     

Horses

 New Horse Textures:  
   
    Normal maps
    Base coat layers & expanded coat colors
    Mane, tail, feathering, and beards
     
 Horse Coat DNA System (Early Stages): Work will begin to lay the groundwork for future breeding mechanics.  

Other

 Steam Test Branch Setup: A dedicated testing branch for community feedback will be introduced before official releases.  

This update will represent one of the biggest steps forward in making the horse world more dynamic, immersive, and realistic. Thank you for supporting development, your feedback helps shape every patch!

notes.title: Early Access 0.2.0.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Another small update with important bug fixes, thank you for your continued feedback!

Fixes & Changes


 Trees and rocks weren’t resetting correctly – this has been fixed.  
 Riding school jobs weren’t available – the timer reset when restarting the game, this has been resolved.  
 New session titles added for multiplayer: “Training” and “Open for all”.  
 Mouse test riding didn’t work – this issue is now fixed.  
 Stirrups changed color when mounting – now behaves correctly.  
 Hotbar no longer highlighted in the inventory – the first row is now correctly marked again.  
 Word filter updated – “Princess” and “Prince” are now allowed.  
 Obstacle stands saved in the editor were resetting to default when spawned – this is fixed.  
 Riding helmets disappeared after entering training – this bug is now fixed.  
 Clothing reverted & items were removed – e.g. black riding pants, high boots, and black helmet – now fixed.  
 Improved save functionality implemented – data should now save more reliably.  
 Processor time calculation now updates properly – even when time is skipped.  
 Planters and field contents didn’t load or couldn’t be harvested properly – this issue is resolved.  
 Sleeping didn’t switch to the next month correctly – the cause was a calculation that only worked in the engine but not in the packaged game.  
 Inventory & equipment sometimes didn’t save when switching to the Player Creator or Obstacle Course Builder – now fixed.  
 Font changed for stall box names – now more readable.  
 Tack set “Kentucky Polka” renamed to “Polka Dots”.  
 Doviran bridles without flash noseband are now displayed correctly.  
 Horse sale prices adjusted – values have been corrected.  
 Lead change issue with purebred horses: We were able to reproduce and fix it, and several tests went fine. However, we are not 100% sure if it could still occur in rare cases.  
 Movement bug after picking up objects in multiplayer: Sometimes triggered after chopping trees, we could not reproduce it again, but are keeping an eye on it.  
 Axe hit detection fixed – should now work more reliably.  

Quality of Life / Improvements

 Added storage area in the garden  
 Added saddle pad hanger in grooming area and blanket hanger on the other side  
 Blanket hangers now support blankets with neck attachments  
 Horse market cycle adjusted – there will now always be at least one purebred horse available  

Planter, Fields & Grass Dryer had to be reset for this hotfix!

Thanks again for testing and reporting! If the update doesn’t show up right away, please restart Steam.

To report bugs, join our Discord server  
or post in the appropriate thread in the Steam discussion forum.

notes.title: What to Expect in 0.2.0.0 - Development Summary
notes.content:
On April 10, 2025, we held a team meeting to discuss the upcoming Update 0.2.0.0 as well as future plans. Here's a look at our current progress on the next major update, which is expected to launch in May!

Horse Care System
One of the most important topics in the discussion was the Horse Care System, which will be expanded over multiple updates and improved & adjusted based on community feedback.

In the upcoming update, not all items in the stalls will be purely decorative anymore.

 The hay net can be filled with hay that has been harvested from your own crops, or alternatively purchased from shops.  
 The feeding trough can be filled with treats like apples or other fruits. In the future, you’ll also be able to use self-produced pellets or other feed!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/bb6d61d9d0ac18f705ac28713dc3ca8437a286f9.gif
In addition to the health, hunger & cleanliness status displays, a new one will be added: the Fatigue Bar, which will be explained in more detail in a separate post.

In the current version (Early Access 0.1.0.2 – Hotfix), none of the status values are functional yet, but of course, we want to change that! We'll begin with the Fatigue and Hunger stats.

Stable Manager
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/c1cf74620a47511efd91246ad7a75da864098c77.png
The new Stable Manager will be accessible via a bulletin board on the ground floor of the stable. Once the player interacts with it, a map of your stable will open. This map is interactive, allowing quick and easy access to all areas of the stable.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/b934206b9ab18fee415894a607fd210c03ad714e.png
When you click on a stall, you'll get a detailed overview with the following options:

 A horse can be assigned to the selected box. That horse will then spawn in this box going forward.  
 The hay net & feeding trough can be filled and customized in color.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/4dd9acccd06c5bd86f9f17c68d4b83a66ad09709.png

Farming
The farming system will expand many gameplay elements, including crafting, the horse care system, and provides another method to earn money! For this feature, the garden behind the house will become accessible.

We’ll have various types of harvestable plants. Here are some examples:
Single harvest¹  

 Carrots  
 Beetroot  
 Grass  
 Various plants for creating dyes 
 
Multiple harvests²  

 Blueberries  
 Apples 
 

¹Single harvest means these plants provide one yield and must be replanted afterward.  
²Multiple harvests means the plant only needs to be planted once and will regularly yield produce, like bushes or trees.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/15f5fd8fb137c2f7dd62171ff05958a69026a263.png

Hayloft
The attic of your stable will serve as a hayloft where you can place harvested grass into several "grass dryers." Once dried, it becomes hay. You can use this hay to feed your horses, fill the hay nets, or sell it.

Crafting Expansion
We want to introduce crafting for various types of horse tack, including gear that can only be crafted and gear that can also be purchased from NPCs. Crafting won’t just help you get special gear, but also offer a way to make money.

Alongside crafting gear, we’ll also provide the option to recolor items.

Here are two example recipes:
Crafting a saddle pad (can also be purchased):  
[olist]
 Fabric  
 xxx Pax (In-game currency)
[/olist]
Recoloring a saddle pad:  
[olist]
 White saddle pad  
 Red dye  
 xxx Pax (In-game currency) 
[/olist] 
For Update 0.2.0.0, a "handful" of new crafting options will first be added at the blacksmith.

Horse Editor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/7eabc580140c1a5d947fbe238df7754d482e132a.png
Many of you requested the ability to rename purchased horses and change their hairstyles and color, including forelock, mane, and tail.
In the grooming area, you’ll soon be able to give your horses a whole new look!
We’ll also be adding brand-new hairstyles!

Horse Market Overhaul
Currently, the horse market always offers the same horses. We want to change that using in-game time. Every in-game week, new horses will be available, some of them randomly generated to bring more variety. Both mixed breeds and purebreds will be available!

Obstacle Course Builder Expansion
Higher jumps up to class M will be added. Additionally, you’ll be able to place decoratives on the ground.

Multiplayer Communication
To make communication with other players easier, we’ll be adding preset phrases and emotes.

We understand that many players would love an in-game chat, but unfortunately we cannot ensure safety, especially for younger players so we’ve decided not to include this feature for now.

Mini-Map
Some players had trouble finding their way around, so we decided to add a mini-map. It will show harvestable plants like Nettle and indicate your character’s current viewing direction.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/c7ebf977e2e8e701504e7af39be23cabf4c2db20.png

General
We aim to add more Quality of Life features overall and to explain or implement many functions in a more user-friendly way. This will also be part of ongoing improvements spread across multiple updates. Thanks to the community’s feedback, we know where to focus our efforts!

notes.title: Early Access 0.1.0.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

 Silver/Gold Horse Ticket: It was previously possible to purchase more than 4 horses, but the horse was not actually added, and the ticket was incorrectly removed. This issue has been fixed.
 Sleeping: Issues with the Sleeping feature have been resolved.
 Index Entries: Index entries no longer reappear every time you join a training session.
 Item Pickup: When attempting to pick up multiple items quickly, only one would be added to the inventory. This has been corrected.
 Music: Some soundtracks that were not looping correctly have been adjusted to now repeat properly.


Visual and Gameplay Adjustments:

 Color Update: The colors of the Stride Indicator and Stamina bar have been updated.
 Tree Felling & Ore Mining: Animations for tree felling and ore mining have been sped up. Additionally, the current animation now fades out faster when a "hit" is registered, allowing the next hit to be executed immediately.
 Alfalfa, Nettle & Trees: These objects have been visually updated to make them easier to identify.
 Textures: Some textures that appeared muddy and were not loading correctly have been fixed so that they now display properly at all times.


New Features & Adjustments:

 Key Binding: A new key binding has been added to drop "Carry Items" (items you can hold but are not in the equipment slot).
 EXP and Reward System: The EXP and reward system has been adjusted for a better gameplay experience.
 Menu Changes: The "Back to Home" button in the menu bar has been replaced with the Map Selection (Travel) button.
 Silver/Gold Tickets: The prices of the Silver and Gold Tickets have been reduced.
 Riding School: Snow and puddles no longer appear inside the Riding School buildings.
 Cross-Country Obstacles: The Cross-Country obstacles in the Campground have been adjusted for beginners.
 Music: 3 new soundtracks got added.
 Quest Window: Quests now scroll automatically down when you get more tasks.


Quest Changes:

 Riding School: The order of quests within the Riding School has been changed.
Reworked Quests:
 "Interaction & Storage"
 "Get to Know Your Horse"
 "Check Out Your Property"
 New Quest: A new quest has been added. It becomes available from Samuel Albrecht after completing the quest "Locate the Blacksmith’s Workshop in Town."


Additional Changes:

 Graphics Preset: A new Graphics Preset option has been added.
 Hint Text: The hint text for going to sleep, as well as the text size and font, has been updated.
 Index Entries: The "Riding Interface" index entry has been updated.
 Item Name: The item name "Red Apple" has been changed to "Apple."

notes.title: Early Access 0.1.0.1 - Hotfix
notes.content:
General Improvements & Bug Fixes:  

Players who assigned their horse to the Stamina Path did not receive EXP – this issue has been fixed.  
Stamina EXP can now be earned based on stamina consumption and distance traveled.  
EXP rewards are now correctly calculated.  
When a path reaches the maximum level (10), this is now properly displayed in the Horse Manager.  
The Agility Path now grants less EXP.  
Show Jumping challenges for classes E, A, and L are now available. Hovering over the buttons will now display the requirements needed to unlock each class.  
Agility EXP is now gained through automatic lead changes.  
Jeremiah had an incorrectly assigned talk text that was non-functional – this has been removed.   
During Show Jumping training, the horse no longer keeps moving in the background when the result screen is displayed.  
Some hay decals in the Riding School had poor blending with other objects – this has been fixed.  
The "Job Offer" timer now includes "h" and "m" for hours and minutes, as some players were unsure about the time format.  
Some SFX could not be lowered via the settings – this issue has been fixed.  
The stable entrance doors on the Riding School map now open wider to allow horses to pass through more easily. (Visually, this might look a bit odd from the outside, but until we can replace the mesh, this is the best solution.)  
The text size of some hint messages has been adjusted.  
A problem has been fixed where the job horses at the Riding School were no longer interactable after rejoining the map while the job was active.


Gameplay Adjustments:  

For jobs requiring item deliveries, items are now correctly removed from the inventory and recognized.
Horses can now become Exhausted:  
If a horse's stamina reaches 0, it enters the Exhausted state.  
In this state, the horse is downgraded to at least "Trot."  
The Exhausted status is lifted once stamina regenerates above 20%.  
While Exhausted, the horse cannot go faster than "Trot" and cannot jump.  
Fixed an issue where players could switch to canter during a jump even when stamina was depleted.
Night can now be skipped: Starting at 18:00 (6 PM), you can interact with your bed.  
A numerical error in Beginner Course 06 has been corrected.  
The feeding animation has been fixed.  
The Show Jumping ESC menu no longer causes players to get stuck when closing it.  


Final Notes:  
For this hotfix, we primarily focused on fixing the most common bugs, as far as it was currently possible.  
Some bugs could not be reproduced, making it difficult to identify the cause. I will reach out to certain players who encountered these issues to ask for additional details and assistance.  

For your information: 
As a team, we had a productive brainstorming session about the future of Unbridled: That Horse Game and the next steps ahead. Once we have cleaned up the current state of the game, we will share more details with you.  
We would like to express our gratitude to everyone for their support! It has been a bumpy start, but we are passionately moving forward. We take all feedback and suggestions seriously, and they are always open for discussion.

notes.title: CLOSED BETA UPDATE 0.4.0 - HORSE ABILITIES, ARCHERY & MORE! 🏹🐴
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW?  

• Archery is back!: It was a big wish of the community to have archery back.
Even though there are no bound actions for it yet in update 0.4.0, you can purchase the bow from Florian Himmel and get familiar with it.
Archery works both on foot and while riding. 🎯  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/12feb4880829af62dee55025e30815bdf1b55e2b.jpg

• Obstacle Course Builder: Create your own jumping courses and share them in multiplayer! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/dcae6cfc9e36ce1294e2acb08836f52084abbad5.jpg
 
• Horse Ability System: Build a bond with your horse, level up, and unlock unique destinies: Jumping, Agility, Stamina, and more! You decide which path your horse will take: will it become a racehorse or perhaps a jumping master? With perks, you can compensate for your horse's weaknesses or further enhance the stats it already excels in!
This is just the beginning of the system, but we are continuously working on refining it to its fullest potential.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/e37dd1f3017f63637018b8e011294c37b3645eb8.jpg

• Jobs: Take on various tasks from the Job Board at the Horse Market to earn extra money. 
• The Axe & The Pickaxe: You now have the ability to chop down trees and break rocks in the campground to gather resources like wood or iron. These activities are especially important for the new jobs you can take on at the job board. 
• Resource Gathering: Chop down trees and mine ores! Check out the Horse Market shop for the necessary tools.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/cfdab0656e46db2703b0bb494b62392049ce949a.jpg

• New Horse Interactions:  
   - Scratch your horse's rump, they’ll love it! ❤️  
   - Boop the nose! 🐴  
• Date & Time: Introducing a Date & Time system that allows various events to occur over time. For example, your horses will get hungry over time, you will have daily bonding tasks (such as brushing and hoof cleaning), and job offers will appear on the job board. This system will be crucial for both farming and breeding in the future.

CHANGES:  

• Improved Animations: Smoother riding, mounting, dismounting, and improved horse gallop.  
• More Lively Maps: Birds and insects now bring more life to the world.  
• Player Creator Update: All hairstyles now have proper thumbnails.  
• Expanded Graphics Settings: Some players experienced issues with low frame rates. In addition to general optimizations, we have added the following options to the graphics settings:
- Anti-Aliasing Quality
- Post Processing
- Global Illumination
- Reflections
- Textures
- Effects
- Shading
• Visual Item Changes:  
   - Casual Riding Helmet has a new look.  
   - Grooming Set has been improved and renamed.  

FIXES:  

• Fixed a graphics issue causing everything to appear red for players with Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics.  
• Reins now display the correct color.  
• Turnout yard gates were mistakenly labeled as barn doors -> now corrected.  
• Key bindings now save properly.  
• Fixed an issue where horses would freeze when led into a stall.  
• Horses can no longer walk on campground chairs.  
• Players will no longer get stuck when riding and changing horse equipment.  

KNOWN ISSUES:  

• Horses currently do not get dirty.

notes.title: CLOSED BETA UPDATE 0.3.0 – OUR BIGGEST UPDATE YET! 🌟
notes.content:
CLOSED BETA UPDATE NEWS 🎉

It’s been a long time without an update, but we haven’t been sitting around doing nothing! Behind the scenes, we’ve been working hard on the game, and now it’s finally here – you can play the result yourself!


WHAT'S NEW?

• Tack Hangers: Organize your equipment with hangers for bridles, halters, saddles, and saddle pads.  
• Carry Tack by Hand: Hold bridles, halters, boots, saddles, blankets, and saddle pads for added realism.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/ff3d94a1125acb9d5c10376d7a26025244eb372e.jpg

• New Starter Quests: Fresh tasks to help you begin your adventure!  
• New Maps:  
  - Falkenberg Riding School: A stunning training and riding destination.  
  - Local Horse Market: Explore a lively market filled with horses and gear.  
• Mailbox System: Check your in-game mail for updates, rewards, and more.  
• Gameplay Index: A growing guide with all the info you need about the game. (Not filled yet)
• Test Ride Horses: Try out horses before deciding to buy them.  
• New Shop Items: Find new horse tack and stylish clothing at the Horse Market shop.  
• New Music: A fresh track to enhance the game atmosphere.  
• Expanded Horse Ownership: Own up to four horses at once!
• New Sleep Feature: You can now go to sleep in your room by interacting with the bed. Time will reset to 7:00.  

• Beginner Show Jumping Courses: Learn the ropes of show jumping at the riding school.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/69b13b4f82691f73c2aae46129fef065547951c5.png

• New Bonding Actions: You can now pat and hug your horse. ❤️  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/fa496f8d8411cedba84c955b43ad727b1d098462.png

• New Item: Horse Tickets  
  - Silver Ticket: Customize your horse with limited markings and colors.  
  - Gold Ticket: Go all out and create your dream horse with no limits!  
• New NPCs:  
  - Clarissa Falkenberg: The owner of Falkenberg Riding School.  
  - Florian Himmel: The shopkeeper at the Horse Market.
• New Horse Equipment System with multiple attachment options!
  - Right-click the item to automatically attach it to the correct slot.
  - Drag & Drop the item onto the correct equipment slot.
  - Drag & Drop the item directly onto the horse.
  - First, hold the item in your hand and stand in front of the horse to attach it manually.

CHANGES:

• Player Character Upgrade: Your character has a brand-new look and improved graphics.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/4557713bb063628331ab54761450d6a281dfa1b8.png

• Updated Player Animations: Smoother and more realistic walking animations.  
• Map Rename: "Forest Valley" is now called Campground and has been reworked.  
• Horse Creator & Player Creator Revamp: Both tools have been completely redesigned.
• UI Overhaul: The entire user interface has been refreshed for a better experience. 
 
• Improved Horse Care: More detailed grooming and hoof cleaning! Use two different brushes to remove various dirt: hard brushes like curry combs for tough dirt and soft brushes for dust.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/5d598bde9df911e98f0cca875e449864ad5fc4ea.png

• Home Stable Overhaul: Your stable has been redesigned with new buildings to explore. 
• Landscape Upgrade: The entire game world has received a stunning overhaul with improved grass, textures, and lighting. Everything looks more vibrant and realistic!  
• Improved Lighting: Adjusted and enhanced light settings for a more realistic look.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/daa786bf3f46eff3515c7cb31a505ea08124f013.jpg

KNOWN ISSUES  

• Key Commands Reset: Key bindings in the settings are reset each time the game is launched.  
• Multiplayer Pole Bug: Jump poles sometimes disappear. To reset them, simply walk through the obstacle again.  
• Multiplayer Sitting Bug: If players are already sitting when you join, you won’t see it. You need to sit again.  
• Graphic Glitch on High Settings and above: When graphics are set to "High" or higher, square visual glitches may appear on the landscape.  
• Multiplayer Tack Bug: Reins and stirrups sometimes do not attach correctly in multiplayer sessions.

We are actively working to resolve these issues—thank you for your patience and feedback!

Jump in now to explore all these exciting updates! 🐴✨

If you discover any bugs, please report them either via email at support@mindevgames.com or, preferably, on our Discord server. Thank you!

Want to join the Closed Beta? Click here for more info!

notes.title: Unbridled: That Horse Game is switching to Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/ad3fc275643385027cd578db77708fc7c85aa3b8.png

Yep, that's right! We are moving from Unreal Engine 4 to 5!
So what does that mean?

The game will get a massive performance AND graphics boost!
Thanks to the new features that are provided by version 5, like Nanite and Lumen!

What is Lumen?
Lumen is a fully dynamic global illumination and reflections solution that enables indirect lighting to adapt on the fly to changes to direct lighting or geometry—for example, changing the sun’s angle with the time of day or opening an exterior door.
With Lumen, we no longer have to author lightmap UVs, wait for lightmaps to bake, or place reflection captures; what we see inside the Unreal Editor is what we get on console.

What is Nanite?
We are able to create games and worlds with massive amounts of geometric detail with Nanite, a virtualized micropolygon geometry system, and a new Virtual Shadow Map system.
We can directly import and replicate multi-million-polygon meshes while maintaining a real-time frame rate without any noticeable loss of fidelity.
These systems intelligently stream and process only the detail you can perceive, largely removing poly count and draw call constraints.

Also with the switch there will be lots of updates in the Patreon test phases (Link down below)! The stable map, Character and the customizer, Inventory, Horse customizer, Horse animations and Obstacle Course Builder will get all a big rework! Of course new things will come as well! Stay tuned!

This will be the biggest update yet, so please give us some time to make it work flawlessly! The free Demo will also be on Unreal Engine 5!
